title: Price any paint job in minutes
text: Painters! Still pricing jobs on a napkin? Meet Coatwright, the app that prices any paint job in minutes.

title: Set up once
text: Set it up once. Add your business name, your logo, and your rates. Pick a starting point, and you're ready to go.

title: Quote any job, fast
text: Start a quote. Pick the property, enter the square footage, or go room by room. Add exterior, cabinets, or a garage floor. The price updates with every tap.

title: Pick the paint
text: For every room, pick the brand, colour and sheen, and see exactly how much paint it needs.

title: Know what to buy
text: Your paint tally adds it all up, room by room, so you know exactly what to buy, and what it costs.

title: Send a pro quote
text: Your customer gets a clean, itemized quote with your logo. Email it, text it, or save a P D F, before you even leave the driveway.

title: Win it. Track it. Get paid.
text: Won the job? Log the deposit and payments, and turn it into an invoice with one tap.

title: Know what you really make
text: Then see what you really made this year. Your profit, your real hourly rate, and the money still owed to you.
Coatwright. Try it free for fourteen days, no credit card needed. Send your first quote today.
